subject.title: fix(sessions): detect adopted turns across short reads

question: Should `readFileRangeAsync` be accepted as a supported public Plugin SDK capability for transcript-scanning providers?
rationale: The functional fix is narrow, but exporting and documenting a new SDK helper establishes a compatibility commitment that cannot be resolved from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Approve the SDK capability
options.body: Accept the documented bounded-reader helper as a supported external-plugin contract and retain focused short-read coverage for both bundled scanners.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Provide an owner-approved session-catalog capability or refactor the implementation so the behavior is available without exposing this config-owned helper as public SDK API.

recommendation.title: Approve the SDK capability
recommendation.body: Accept the documented bounded-reader helper as a supported external-plugin contract and retain focused short-read coverage for both bundled scanners.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership history was not available in the supplied review context, so a concrete individual should not be guessed.
